description: Update a feature and return it; omitted fields are unchanged. status is 'active' | 'discovered' | 'archived' (there is NO 'shipped' status — set mark_shipped:true to stamp its ship date instead). target_date is 'YYYY-MM-DD' (or null to clear). Resolve the id via list_features; only id is required.

id.description: Feature id to update, from list_features (required).

initiative_id.description: Align under this initiative (line-of-sight), from list_initiatives; null unlinks (optional).

mark_shipped.description: true stamps the ship date now; false clears it (optional).

objective_id.description: Align directly under this objective, from list_objectives; null unlinks (optional).

target_date.description: Target ship date 'YYYY-MM-DD', or null to clear (optional).

name: update_feature
title: Update Feature
